items.title: ChlCast: High-Resolution AI Chlorophyll-a Forecasting
items.summary: Researchers introduce ChlCast, an AI model that generates daily surface chlorophyll-a forecasts over a 10-day horizon at approximately 4-km resolution between 60°S and 60°N. ChlCast significantly reduces errors compared to operational global biogeochemical forecasting systems and preserves coastal gradients.
keyPoints: Covers latitudes between 60°S and 60°N at 4-km resolution.
Reduces MAE and RMSE compared to operational Copernicus forecasting systems.
Retains coastal gradients and localized concentration maxima.

en.title: ChlCast: High-Resolution AI Chlorophyll-a Forecasting
en.summary: Researchers introduce ChlCast, an AI model that generates daily surface chlorophyll-a forecasts over a 10-day horizon at approximately 4-km resolution between 60°S and 60°N. ChlCast significantly reduces errors compared to operational global biogeochemical forecasting systems and preserves coastal gradients.
keyPoints: Covers latitudes between 60°S and 60°N at 4-km resolution.
Reduces MAE and RMSE compared to operational Copernicus forecasting systems.
Retains coastal gradients and localized concentration maxima.

fr.title: ChlCast : Prévision d'chlorophylle-a par IA à haute résolution
fr.summary: Des chercheurs présentent ChlCast, un modèle d'IA qui génère des prévisions quotidiennes de chlorophylle-a de surface sur un horizon de 10 jours à environ 4 km de résolution entre 60°S et 60°N. ChlCast réduit considérablement les erreurs par rapport aux systèmes opérationnels.
keyPoints: Couvre les latitudes entre 60°S et 60°N avec une résolution de 4 km.
Réduit l'erreur absolue moyenne et l'erreur quadratique moyenne par rapport au système Copernicus.
Préserve les gradients côtiers et les maxima de concentration localisés.

items.title: Cross-Linguistic Acoustic Biomarkers of Cognitive Impairment
items.summary: A cross-linguistic and cross-task acoustic analysis across four languages reveals that temporal features robustly capture timing disruption, while speech rate and pitch exhibit task and language dependencies.
keyPoints: Analyzed conversational and structured speech across Spanish, Mandarin, English, and Japanese.
Temporal features remained robustly consistent across all datasets and tasks.
Pitch and speech rate showed strong language-specific and task-dependent patterns.

en.title: Cross-Linguistic Acoustic Biomarkers of Cognitive Impairment
en.summary: A cross-linguistic and cross-task acoustic analysis across four languages reveals that temporal features robustly capture timing disruption, while speech rate and pitch exhibit task and language dependencies.
keyPoints: Analyzed conversational and structured speech across Spanish, Mandarin, English, and Japanese.
Temporal features remained robustly consistent across all datasets and tasks.
Pitch and speech rate showed strong language-specific and task-dependent patterns.

fr.title: Biomarqueurs acoustiques interlinguistiques des troubles cognitifs
fr.summary: Une analyse acoustique interlinguistique et inter-tâches menée dans quatre langues révèle que les caractéristiques temporelles capturent solidement les perturbations, tandis que le débit et la hauteur vocale dépendent des tâches et des langues.
keyPoints: Étude menée en espagnol, mandarin, anglais et japonais.
Les caractéristiques temporelles restent robustes dans tous les ensembles de données.
La hauteur et le débit de parole montrent de fortes dépendances linguistiques.
